Yoghurt chicken with peppers

Ingredients

For the chicken

500g chicken thighs

2 tbsp Turkish or Greek yoghurt

For the vegetables

2 red peppers

Method

Marinate the chicken for 30 minutes.

Heat the oven to 220C and roast the chicken and peppers.
